shared.doc: /** 📐️ The shared invite redemption fixture type. */

files.doc: /** 🎟️ The fixture contract, sqlite oracle and hostile call checks of the invite redemption transaction proof. */

phases.name: checkRedemptionFixtureContract
phases.doc: Loads the invite redemption fixture and checks its schema, limits, vector names and acceptance marker.

phases.name: checkRedemptionOracleVectors
phases.doc: Replays every redemption vector against the sqlite oracle.

phases.name: checkRedemptionCallsAndHostiles
phases.doc: Checks every redemption call against the call schema and every hostile mutation against the fixture.

files.doc: /** 🔒️ The production source closure checks of the invite redemption transaction proof. */

phases.name: checkRedemptionSourceClosure
phases.doc: Reads the directory backend sources and checks the redemption transaction closure with its hostile mutations.

phases.name: checkStateAuthorityClosure
phases.doc: Checks the invite state and ingress authority closure with its hostile mutations.

phases.name: checkArchiveClosure
phases.doc: Checks the archive transaction and rollback closure with its hostile mutations.
